title: Quiet Saturday
summary: Jordan spent a quiet Saturday running errands, buying a green rug that Pepper immediately claimed, and cooking a proper chicken dinner instead of eating on the couch. The mood was calm and unremarkable, punctuated only by Pepper knocking over a water glass at 2am, and Jordan seemed content to let the day be uneventful, noting that "sometimes that's fine." No real decisions were made beyond small domestic choices.
